annotations.title: Record a manager’s payment of a pool invoice

description: Use this when the user says their manager paid the invoice for a fee pool it funds and is invoiced for, from its own bank account. Starts recording that payment; any other payment is marked paid on the fund’s Expenses tab, not here. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed record for the user to confirm. This call records nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York
